messages:
Lina (PM): folks — planning note: rather than a single cohort mix, proposing vertical-segmented cohorts (SaaS, healthcare, finserv, marketplace). reasons: cleaner eval signal + tailored comms. thoughts?
Diego (Eng): vertical cohorts make infra config easier (different token patterns). + we can pre-provision model profiles per vertical. downside: smaller N per cohort, but signal quality up.
Renee (PartnerOps): ops impact: need separate intake tracks & marketing copy. can still keep overall target = 24 partners but split 6 per vertical, staggered starts. Also suggest an "onboarding buddy" assigner so each partner has a PO contact.
Hiro (Res): research prefers mixed cohorts for cross-vertical comparisons, but vertical cohorts help optimize prompts & metrics. compromise: run two vertical cohorts + one mixed cohort. require 3 canonical prompts + a usage snippet at sign-up.
Nora (Legal): flagged items: finserv/healthcare require a short intake checkbox to trigger compliance review. NDA language should reference pilot data handling and optional log-sharing consent. allow opt-out for telemetry.
Lina (PM): feedback SLA: partners submit prioritized bugs/asks in our portal; Res/Eng triage within 3 biz days; bug fixes or workarounds prioritized into weekly triage. we should promise response time, not commit-to-fix.
Diego (Eng): agree. add an internal "pilot steering" label so Eng can filter incoming issues. Also create a lightweight rollback policy per cohort in case a change causes regressions.
Renee (PartnerOps): onboarding timeline suggestion: invite -> 12 biz day RSVP -> intake -> auto-smoke eval -> kickoff w/in 10 biz days after NDA. automation: ops-bot will send reminders + escalate to PO on non-response.
ops-bot: automation set: reminders day 4, day 9, escalate day 11.
Hiro (Res): metrics we need from infra: avg latency P50/P95 per model variant, token-cost per request, synthetic-quality pass rate on seed prompts. capture these in cohort dashboard.
Diego (Eng): will add both infra metrics + a small webhook summary to cohort channel. rate-limited to 1 post/hour.
Lina (PM): success criteria for vertical cohort experiment: 1) at least 4 active partners (>= 200 tokens/week) per cohort, 2) avg synthetic-quality >= baseline+5%, 3) 3 productizable asks across cohorts, 4) partner satisfaction >= 25 NPS.
Renee (PartnerOps): incentive tweak: base credits + milestone credits when partners complete 3 eval runs and a post-kickoff interview. also offer early access to roadmap features for high engagement.
Nora (Legal): final note: confirm data residency opt-in during intake; document any special export restrictions before kickoff.
Lina (PM): owners: Renee = invite & copy, Hiro = eval config, Diego = infra + dashboard, Nora = intake legal checks. target send = next Tue. I'll draft segmented invite copy and post for review.
Renee (PartnerOps): copying a short intake skeleton to the sheet now.
Diego (Eng): tagging runtime on the sheet for capacity planning.
Lina (PM): thanks — will schedule a 15-min sync tomorrow to finalize. :sparkles:
